name: Ọfọ & Bronze: Chronicles of Nri
author: Stratum
description: A pen-and-paper campaign, played in the action game.

classes.name: Eze Nri Diviner
classes.title: Dibia Afa
classes.description: Mediator of moral balance who reads the Afa seeds and calls down Amadioha's spear.

classes.name: Ekpe Leopard Stalker
classes.title: Onye Ekpe
classes.description: Initiate of the leopard society: stealth, speed and Nsibidi cyphers.

enemies.name: Mmụọ Masquerade
enemies.description: An ancestral spirit walking in a mask of raffia and bronze.

lore.title: Ịgba Afa
lore.body: The diviner casts the seeds on the Akwali board, and the pattern they fall in is the answer the ancestors chose to give.
lore.subject: nri:afa_divination

checks.name: Afa Divination
checks.description: Cast divination seeds on the sacred Akwali board to read cosmic omens.

checks.name: Ogu War Cry
checks.description: Strike your bronze shield and chant the deeds of ancestors to shatter enemy resolve.

checks.name: Ekpe Leopard Evasion
checks.description: Move as the leopard society moves: unseen, then everywhere at once.

checks.name: Ikenga Consecration
checks.description: Anoint the horned Ikenga, shrine of the strong right hand.
